      "observations": [
        "All eligible owned changed hunks across the 68-path feedback migration were read. The mixed nsMsgOfflineManager.cpp contains one removed Suite-only conditional, old lines 178–180, which was inadvertently exposed in an initial shared-file output before detection. It is not studied as Thunderbird evidence. Publisher input omits that entire file from the path-selected diff and retains only disjoint exact eligible pre/post snapshots; excluded text is not copied. Full all-content diff coverage is not claimed.",
        "The migration replaces native nsMsgStatusFeedback registration, strong/weak window and URL feedback plumbing and protocol status sinks with the registered JavaScript nsIFeedbackService exposed by MailServices.feedback. The original status-feedback IDL remains empty and sendMessageFile keeps an ignored placeholder; deleting those is the separate 4858 phase. UI nsMsgStatusFeedback remains a status/activity consumer.",
        "reportStatus posts {statusMessage,meteors} to all enumerated windows. reportProgress suppresses an unchanged value or an exact transition from 0 to 100, then posts to the most recent window. Its last-progress field initially has no value, unlike the deleted native object's zero initializer. The old native 250 ms throttling is removed, while UI queue/timer behavior remains separate. The two existing focused payload/progress lessons are reused; emitting two fields does not prove every consumer processes both.",
        "The primary and full own review preserve the UI-widget-owned presentation explanation, added interface documentation, UTF-8 suggestion adopted by the IDL, and rejection of renaming the postMessage event away from message. Later post-landing progress/meteors questions and author reply do not erase the actual main-window if/else boundary. They are concerns/responses, not independent runtime confirmation.",
        "The mail-window consumer adds message-based status/progress/meteors handling and moves messagepane network start/stop display to contentProgress. FilterListDialog independently reads status and meteors; the original stop block comments out the run-button enable assignment and changes running state. Accepted code later guards on gRunningFilters and no longer owns those button transitions in the message handler; the original block is not current behavior or a demonstrated user failure.",
        "Shared offline, compactor, IMAP, mailbox, POP3, NNTP, junk, feed and EWS producers now obtain the service instead of a specific msgWindow feedback object. Some formatting now runs without a window, and ParseFolder now requires its localization service/bundle before starting. EWS delete/sync success and failure callbacks reacquire the service for stop feedback; activity-manager progress and copy/send listeners remain separate completion channels. No protocol operation or cross-window message delivery was run.",
        "The exact prepared-send caller passes _sendProgress as nsIMsgProgress to the outgoing server. SmtpServer queries it for nsIWebProgressListener and reports byte counts. Rust EWS outgoing accepts the corresponding optional interface. MessageSend still waits for requestPromise to represent send start and a cancellation handle, not successful final delivery. The small-send test now checks three taskbar states; the large-send assertion now allows equal progress values.",
        "The native news cancel API gains an optional URL listener so its unit test can await PromiseUrlListener instead of a dummy window's stop-meteors event. The original C++ implementation nonetheless rejects a null listener, while the same landing's UI caller passes null and its IDL says listener if any. Accepted code no longer has that guard. This is a historical caller/guard mismatch and later code phase, not a claim of a present failure.",
        "ParseFolder's completion lambda now returns on failure to format localStatusDocumentDone before calling FinishUpAfterParseFolder. At the fixed revision that order remains. StoreIndexer accepts std::function<void(nsresult)> and invokes it without using a result; FinishUpAfterParseFolder clears m_parsingFolder and notifies the reparse listener/folder-loaded event. Therefore a formatting failure follows a path that skips that folder cleanup. Failure reachability and any user-visible stuck state were not reproduced.",
        "Direct test coverage is narrower than a general protocol success claim. Status-feedback tests register mutation waits for the first 10 of 25 messages before awaiting all and asserting completion; later dropped messages are not individually asserted absent. Three send-later progress assertions are removed from one unit listener, so executing that empty callback is not progress-result coverage. NNTP cancellation still checks remaining message count, with an existing message-less Assert.equal in the owned hunk; no assertion message is inferred from its task name. Existing deleted message-less progress assertions are not taught as preferred style.",
        "Cleanup helpers switch from synchronous private _stopMeteors calls to posted service messages; one visible-progress branch adds an event-loop turn. This supports an asynchronous cleanup contract, not a guarantee that a fixed timer delay proves all windows delivered their messages. Undo predicates use !!array.length or !array.length on the actual filtered-array helper. Calendar status feedback merely renames its private display method and its own internal callers.",
        "Manual source review keeps early zero-total/error returns and concrete service/caller names distinct from local truthiness cleanups. The original IDL documentation leaves presentation policy to widgets; its parameter documentation name differs from the literal status argument, so it is not a global JSDoc example. Nested payload branches have a concrete exclusive-field effect. No automatic style rule, native warning, formatter or accessibility result is inferred.",
        "The entire retained primary current description, comments 0–4, activity and ending controls was read. Original service/window removal, last-reference cleanup and later documentDone cleanup are separate landings; regression links are retained locators with unknown mechanisms here.",
        "The retained original D286115 creation-to-final and later post-landing human discussion plus all 16 actual inline bodies were already read completely during C3 collection and are reused without new browser navigation or another body copy. Documentation/UTF-8 requests are checked against source; postMessage naming objection is explicitly rebutted/resigned, and later payload questions remain distinct from observed code."
